name: Steam
author: Forsythe McSquiddington
description: Steam playtime this week, with a Play button and a how-long-to-beat rundown for every game.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: hours by day, the games you played this week, a Play button on each, and total time plus estimated length when a row is unfolded.

schema.label: Week
schema.description: What "this week" means. Either way it is measured from daily snapshots the collector keeps; until seven days exist, Steam's two-week total stands in.
